title: YEEZY BOOST 350 V2 INFANT
description: Debuting in late March, 2019, the adidas Yeezy Boost 350 V2 'Clay' marked the first time a 350 would be released in adult, kids and infant sizes. The infant-sized Yeezy Boost 350 V2 Infant 'Clay' mimics the larger versions, with a Primeknit upper that features a variety of patterns in orange-brown with a horizontal contrast stripe. A bright orange heel tab adds an accent, and the silhouette sits atop a translucent midsole and rubber outsole.

title: YEEZY BOOST 350 V2 INFANT
description: The Yeezy Boost 350 V2 Infant maintains the distinctive elements of Kanye West's pioneering design inspired by adidas' heritage. Unveiled in September 2019, this non-reflective Cloud White kid's iteration is realized in Primeknit with an asymmetrical, two-tone stitch pattern, lacing integrated into the tongue and a signature translucent stripe on the lateral side. The midsole is filled with energy-returning Boost technology.

title: YEEZY QUANTUM KIDS
description: The adidas Yeezy Quantum Kids ‘Frozen Blue’ injects a vibrant dose of color to the basketball-inspired silhouette, highlighted by a bright blue RPU cage overlaid across the jacquard knit upper. Black neoprene is utilized on the collar and tongue to deliver a comfortable fit, while a seamless heel counter provides rearfoot stability. The mid-top rides on a full-length drop-in Boost midsole, wrapped in a semi-translucent TPU cage and reinforced with a herringbone rubber outsole.
